description: This PHP class manages database connections for the installer component of the OrangeHRM system, providing connection retrieval and reset functionality using Doctrine DBAL library.

classes.name: DatabaseServerConnection
classes.description: Provides static methods to manage and retrieve a singleton database connection for the installer component.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Returns the singleton database connection, initializing it if necessary.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the stored database connection, allowing it to be reinitialized.
